stem: An operating system is best defined as

options.text: A program that acts as an interface between the user and the hardware and controls the execution of programs
A program that only manages files
The physical parts of the computer

explanation: The OS manages memory, processors, devices and files and controls program execution.
source: Operating System CSC 421 for DLC2.docx, Unit 1

stem: Which are the four main managers of an operating system?
explanation: The fourth is the file manager.
source: Operating System CSC 421 for DLC2.docx, Unit 1

stem: In a batch operating system, users interact with the computer directly while their jobs run.
explanation: Batch users submit jobs offline; lack of interaction is one of the problems of batch systems.
source: Operating System CSC 421 for DLC2.docx, Unit 1

stem: Sharing one processor among two or more programs that reside in memory at the same time is
explanation: Multiprogramming keeps the CPU busy by always having a job to run.

stem: Which one is not a type of operating system described in the unit?
explanation: The types are batch, time-sharing, distributed, network and real-time.
source: Operating System CSC 421 for DLC2.docx, Unit 1

explanation: Communication may be implemented by shared memory or message passing.

stem: Multitasking operating systems are also known as time-sharing systems.
explanation: The CPU switches between jobs so often that users can interact with each program.
